name: In-game favourite carry (taker)
description: Taker: once per NBA/NHL game, buy the team whose ask first reaches 95-99c after the estimated start (start + 30 min), hold to settlement. Late favourites at 95-99c win more often than priced.
hypothesis: Research on clean NBA/NHL books (one entry per game, ask one minute later): +0.98c/ct, se 0.59, 842 games, 5/6 months positive, 3% of games lost ~95c each. Wrong if the walk-forward CI is <= 0 (likely inconclusive: ~140 games/month at ~1c) or the lockbox loses.
next: smoke -> quick -> full; lockbox only if promising.
